Summary:
- Product: VS Code extension platform (inline suggestions, streaming completions, multiple extension tiers).
- Key ask: sub-50ms perceptual latency for inline suggestions, ideally ~20-30ms on warm KV cache; graceful streaming for slow networks.
- Throughput target: 150-250 concurrent editors during peak internal beta (org-wide); avg tokens/sec per editor ~5-8.
- Model strategy: want model/version pinning per-release channel (stable/canary), automatic fallback to a smaller quantized variant when dedicated capacity constrained.
- Auth & rate limits: enterprise SSO/SAML + per-user rate quotas + team-level burst allowances. Must support token refresh flows for extension clients.

- Streaming start within 60ms of first token; no more than 2x degradation on cloudy networks.
- Stable model pinning: can pin ext-version v1.2 -> model-id 'rw-llama2-13b-q4' and roll back via console within 2 minutes.
- Audit logs for suggestion events (user id, model id, prompt hash) retained 90 days.
